facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party three-quarters price for their barrow treasure, tallied at 975 gold pieces. He pays only once the caravans flow to Brandonsford again, which they have not done since the dragon appeared.

The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note, in return for their joining the party. Payment is due when the note can be collected, but the exact shares were never stated.
facts.uncertain_reason: The beats do not say how much of the note each recruit gets or exactly when they are to be paid.
